channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Vlade Divac | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Vlade Divac from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Cuttino Mobley on Yao Ming, Brad Miller, Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Rick Adelman
item.description:
“It’s just the offense didn’t. Say we would’ve had Rick Adelman, for a fact, you would’ve seen more of Yao Ming. Like that Chris Webber, that Vlade Divac, Brad Miller type of passing. He had all of it.”

Cuttino Mobley on Yao Ming, Brad Miller, Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Rick Adelman, Jul 3, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Doug Christie on Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Predrag Stojakovic
item.description:
“[Chris Webber] has texted me numerous times. Bobby [Jackson] has texted me numerous times. Peja [Stojakovic] and Vlade [Divac], things that I can't say, but they definitely have texted me. It's nothing but love for all those guys because without them, I'm not sitting here.”

Doug Christie on Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Predrag Stojakovic, Jan 16, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Dino Radja on Toni Kukoc, Arvydas Sabonis, Vlade Divac, Drazen Petrovic
item.description:
Dino Radja:

“I have to say that I am very proud to be one of the pioneers who opened the road for everybody to NBA. Because, before Drazen Petrovic, Divac, Toni Kukoc, Sabonis, myself… There was no belief in European players…that they can succeed. Afterward, we came in and showed everybody that we can succeed, and now the NBA is open. If you see how many international players are in the NBA right now, it is a huge number.”

Dino Radja on Toni Kukoc, Arvydas Sabonis, Vlade Divac, Drazen Petrovic, Nov 5, 2022. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Sasha Vujacic on Vlade Divac, Drazen Petrovic, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
Vujacic told ClutchPoints.

“And for me, being European coming from Europe, I understand what the journey was to get here. And when these kids back in the day saw what Vlade [Divac], Drazen [Petrovic], [Arvydas] Sabonis, all the pioneers did — without naming everybody — and then what different generations did, they got excited and they understood that hard work will pay off.”

Sasha Vujacic on Vlade Divac, Drazen Petrovic, Domantas Sabonis, Sep 16, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Sasha Djordjevic on Nemanja Bjelica, Vlade Divac, Bogdan Bogdanovic
item.description:
Djordjevic noted that Divac understands the situation as he also experienced the same problems during his career and has provided real help:

“Huge! Divac is exceptionally positive towards us, he understands our obligations. There are a few more details to be taken care of regarding Bogdanovic but as far as Bjelica goes it’s done. Bogdanovic underwent a surgery at the end of the season, so we have to keep an eye, but Vlade is a man who remembers the problems he had while playing with NBA teams and he is exceptionally willing to help. We’ve been in touch for the past three or four nights talking about it. I’m so glad both of them are on his team because it will help them in their further careers”

Sasha Djordjevic on Nemanja Bjelica, Vlade Divac, Bogdan Bogdanovic, Sep 2, 2018. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Vivek Ranadive on Vlade Divac, Dave Joerger
item.description:
Vivek Ranadive:

“Well again, I leave it up to (general manager) Vlade (Divac). What I see is a young guy who wants to win, and has actually matured. And I'm just repeating what I hear Vlade saying, so it's better to ask him this question, but I think what Vlade really wants to see is - and the way he says it with his Serb accent - is hugs (laughs). Hugs. He wants to see hugs, and he wants to see growth as a teammate. I know that Vlade and coach (first-year coach Dave Joerger, formerly of the Memphis Grizzlies) will make the right decisions, and I don't know. Right now what I see is I'm excited for what we have.”

Vivek Ranadive on Vlade Divac, Dave Joerger, Oct 10, 2016. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Vlade Divac
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:DeMarcus Cousins:

“I have a lot of faith in Vlade Divac & the front office... we're in a rough patch now but everything will be fine.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Vlade Divac, Feb 11, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: George Karl on Vlade Divac, Mike Bratz
item.description:
“Fortunately, Vlade Divac is still here and Mike Bratz, our player personnel director . . . we have enough guys to make it work,”

George Karl on Vlade Divac, Mike Bratz, Jun 11, 2015. Source: NewsTalk 1530 KFBK.

item.title: Jerry West on Arn Tellem, Vlade Divac
item.description:
What do you consider a bigger move personally, getting Shaq or Kobe?:Jerry West:

“Trading [Vlade Divac] was difficult, and particularly when you’re trading someone of his caliber — a starting center — for a 17-year-old kid who couldn’t even sign a contract. But we were lucky because I had a great working relationship with Arn Tellem… who used to be Kobe’s agent. Arn was very instrumental in us being able to get him, way down the draft list. Charlotte got a very good player in Vlade Divac, and they played well with him, but at the end of the day we got the prize we wanted. … We got really lucky and that’s what sometimes you need.”

Jerry West on Arn Tellem, Vlade Divac, Feb 20, 2013. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Vlade Divac
item.description:
“I think in international play a technical foul is the penalty for it. Free throw and get the ball back, that sort of thing. But I like the rule. Shameless flopping is just a chump move. We're familiar with it because Vlade (Divac) kind of pioneered it in a playoff series with Shaq (O'Neal). And it worked pretty well for him.”

Kobe Bryant on Vlade Divac, Oct 4, 2012. Source: Orange County Register.
